0.long_answer: The disease is IgA nephropathy, which is commonly known as Berger's disease. IgA nephropathy is characterized by the deposition of immunoglobulin A (IgA) in the glomeruli of the kidneys, leading to persistent microscopic hematuria or episodic gross hematuria. It presents without other significant symptoms in its non-aggressive form, and together with thin basement membrane disease, it is one of the most frequent causes of isolated hematuria.
